artifacts.label: Contract Resolution Summary
artifacts.purpose: Records pinned versions, Modules, Capabilities and canonical definitions resolved for the task.

artifacts.label: Implementation Plan
artifacts.purpose: Defines change scope, boundaries, adapters, tests, migrations and risks before implementation.

artifacts.label: Implementation Report
artifacts.purpose: Reports what changed, which contracts were consumed and what was actually verified.

artifacts.label: Deviation Record
artifacts.purpose: Makes a known implementation deviation visible and bounded.

artifacts.label: Contract Extension Proposal
artifacts.purpose: Proposes new shared canonical coverage instead of silently inventing it in a project.

artifacts.label: Migration Plan
artifacts.purpose: Defines dry-run, compatibility, execution, recovery and integrity checks.

artifacts.label: Security / Data Impact Note
artifacts.purpose: Documents boundary, classification and security implications.

artifacts.label: Verification Evidence
artifacts.purpose: Lists checks that actually ran, results and checks not run.

artifacts.label: Handoff Summary
artifacts.purpose: Leaves the next developer/agent a concise current state and remaining actions.
